title: Engineering Services for Street Standards Modernization
short_description: Planning and engineering services for street standards modernization and right-of-way needs.
project_scope: Professional planning, engineering, and design services to support the Street Standards Modernization and ROW Needs Project. Disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, cost estimating, site evaluation/selection, land use planning, planning/master planning, utility engineering, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning.
services: Professional planning, engineering, and design services for street standards modernization and right-of-way needs; multidisciplinary civil, geotechnical, surveying, planning, utility, traffic, and transportation services.
relevance_explanation:
- Street/highway standards modernization project, not a bridge or special structure.
- Focus is broad planning, ROW needs, and multidisciplinary civil support rather than structural design.
- Includes several services outside sbp core focus such as land use planning, transportation planning, and project management.
- No indication of architecturally demanding, lightweight, long-span, or innovative structural scope.
- Falls close to pure urban/open space/transport planning, which is generally not relevant for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost stated in the source. The notice describes only professional services for planning and engineering support; no project size, length, area, or capital budget is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information stated in the source, and the scope is a broad multidisciplinary services package rather than a clearly defined structural engineering assignment, so a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
